items.notes: Created handler to restart Redis service on configuration change.

items.description: Hiera common defaults → Ansible role defaults (redis_port, redis_password [vault-encrypt], maxmemory_mb, maxmemory_policy)
items.notes: Converted Puppet class parameters to Ansible role defaults. redis_password is an AAP credential variable (not in defaults). Added secure_logging toggle.

items.description: Role argument specs for fail-fast parameter validation (generate after defaults/main.yml is written)
items.notes: Generated argument_specs.yml from defaults/main.yml plus AAP credential variables.

items.description: Main manifest → tasks entry point: redis_role fact logic (stat+grep+set_fact), health check fetch (ansible.builtin.uri), health_check.json file, myapp deployment (stat/get_url/unarchive/copy idempotency), mySecretType1 scheduler registration (NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE — developer review required), PuppetDB peer discovery replaced with inventory group lookup, contain install subclass
items.notes: Fixed 3 issues: (1) Cat4-Ordering: swapped Steps 4 and 5 so myapp is deployed before the health-check URI fetch (myapp serves port 8080); (2) Cat2-Missing app guard: added wait_for port 8080 before uri fetch to ensure myapp is reachable; (3) Cat1-Missing prerequisite: added 'Ensure /var/lib/redis directory exists' task before writing health_check.json to that directory.

items.description: Install subclass → tasks: Redis installation/configuration via external redis role (bind 0.0.0.0, port 6379, requirepass vault-encrypted, maxmemory 2048mb, appendonly, appendfsync everysec), create /var/log/redis directory (owner redis:redis, mode 0755)
items.notes: Converted manifests/install.pp: installs redis package, creates log dir, deploys redis.conf template (with no_log for password), starts/enables service.

items.description: Molecule scenario configuration — delegated driver, local connection (not docker/podman)
Molecule converge playbook — runs the role via a single ansible.builtin.include_role task
items.notes: Single include_role task for profile_redis_cluster_case2. No faked filesystem state.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook — checks /var/lib/redis/health_check.json (exists, owner redis:redis, mode 0644, valid JSON), /var/log/redis (directory, owner redis:redis, mode 0755), /opt/myapp/version.txt (exists, contains 2.1.0), Redis ping (redis-cli -p 6379 -a CHANGEME ping → PONG), health endpoint (curl http://localhost:8080/health → valid JSON)
items.notes: Two plays: filesystem state (log dir, myapp version.txt, health_check.json, redis.conf) and service/port checks (redis.service running+enabled, port 6379 open). All loop vars prefixed, bracket notation used, no bare item.
